title: foods_down
description: Phone → watch. The user's Foods I Eat list — the compact set the wrist quick-logs from — plus the categories that order it. Reference data: the phone owns the food catalog, the watch reads it and never edits it.

category.description: One of the user's active food categories. The phone sends only the categories its Foods I Eat view is grouped by, so the wrist applies the phone's own grouping rules to the phone's own vocabulary.

food.description: One food the wrist may quick-log. A serving is the food's reference amount, so `servings` on the observations_up event is a multiple of it and `caloriesPerServing` is what a serving costs.

categoryId.description: The category this food is grouped under, or null for Uncategorized. A food whose phone-side category is archived, or that has none, carries null.

defaultServings.description: The portion the phone pre-fills: the amount the user logged last, expressed in servings. One when the food has never been logged.
